title: Request coalescing: concurrent misses for one key share a single fetch
caption: Inside one server, the first miss starts the fetch and later requests for the same key wait on it instead of starting their own.

messages.label: GET product:77
messages.note: The local copy has just expired.

messages.label: fetch product:77 (in flight)
messages.note: The first miss registers an in-flight fetch for this key.

messages.label: GET product:77
messages.note: 49 more requests arrive during the 1 ms fetch. They find the in-flight entry and wait.

messages.label: same row, shared
messages.note: 50 requests, 1 shard read. Combined with the local cache, the shard sees one fetch per server per TTL even at the moment of expiry.
